name: Marble daylight
description: The product on a pale marble surface in soft window daylight with a long natural shadow. The everyday hero shot for skincare, food and homeware.
prompt: Product photograph: the product in image 1, unchanged in shape, colour and label, standing on a pale {{ stone }} surface. Soft daylight from a window to the {{ side }}, one long natural shadow, a plain warm wall far behind and out of focus, gentle highlight down the edge of the product. Label sharp and readable. {{#if prop}}{{ prop }} placed nearby, out of focus.{{/if}} No text, no watermark.
negative_prompt: harsh flash, warped label, duplicated product, text, watermark, busy background
